steps.journal: Take a brush wasp stinger from the brush wasps on the hill west of the Roost.

Will you hunt Razortusk?
quests.declined: He will not grow gentler while you wait.
quests.started: East, up the rise past the market nests. Do not let him get behind you.

steps.journal: Take Razortusk's tusk from the old boar Razortusk on the rise east of the Roost.
Bring Razortusk's tusk to Huntmaster Arrok.

Shall I send you north?
quests.declined: The winds will wait for you.
quests.started: Fly well, and do not forget the Roost!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Windwhistle when you are ready to fly to Halas.

quests.started: Mudgrub keeps the cook pots, just south of here. Do not touch them.

steps.journal: Find Grocer Mudgrub by the cook pots in the great hall.
steps.says: The elder sent you? Here, eat this before someone takes it from you. It smells, but so do we.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Snikkit.
steps.says: Good. Mudgrub knows your face now, and you know where the food is. That is half of being a goblin.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the goblins' first, at their home zone, Moss Mouth Cavern of the disc.

steps.journal: Kill five tunnel rats in the pit east of the great hall.

quests.declined: Then go hungry. The swamp does not mind.
quests.started: Sskaya keeps her stall at the west end of the long bridge, just east of here.

steps.journal: Find Grocer Sskaya at the west end of the long bridge.
steps.says: Hsslarn sent you? Then take this, hatchling, and eat it slowly. Bread does not run away.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Hsslarn.
steps.says: Good. A hunter who knows where the food is can wait as long as the prey can, and longer.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the lizardmans' first, at their home zone, Cazic-Thule of the disc.

quests.name: Beetles in the Reeds
quests.offer: Bog beetles have been chewing through my reed baskets. Hunt five of them for me on the southern banks, behind the old temple and on the far side of the east island, and I will make it worth your while.
quests.declined: Then my baskets will have holes in them.
quests.started: Five beetles. Mind the deep water.

steps.journal: Kill five bog beetles on the southern banks, behind the old temple or across the east island.
Tell Grocer Sskaya the beetles are dead.
steps.says: Five! My baskets thank you, and so do I. Here, this is yours.

quests.notes: Ours: the lizardmans' second starter quest; the bog beetles are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: The Road to Freeport
quests.offer: In Freeport the humans pay good coin for a blade that does not tire, and they ask few questions. I can send you there, and it will be your home from then on. Are you ready to go?
quests.declined: The coin will keep. So will Freeport.
quests.started: Hunt well, and send word home now and then!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Vosskar when you are ready to go to Freeport.

quests.name: A Seat at the Table
quests.offer: Welcome, welcome! A new face in the glade is a fine thing. Now, the first thing any brownie learns is where the food is kept. Go and say hello to Pippkin. She keeps the larder.
quests.declined: Hungry later, then! Do not say I did not tell you.
quests.started: Pippkin is just over there, by the tent. You will smell the larder.

steps.journal: Say hello to Grocer Pippkin by the tent in the glade's stockade.
steps.says: Thimbleroot sent you? Then you must be starving. Here, take a muffin. Take two, nobody is counting.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Thimbleroot.
steps.says: There, you see? Fed and friended in one morning. You will make a fine brownie yet.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the brownies' first, at their home zone, Mayfly Glade of the disc.

quests.name: Mayflies in the Berries
quests.offer: Mayfly swarms are in the berry patches again, and they spoil more than they eat. Be rid of five of them for good, out in the open glade west of the stockade, and I will pay you well.
quests.declined: Then we will have very few berries this year.
quests.started: Five swarms. Mind your ears, they buzz terribly.

steps.journal: Kill five mayfly swarms in the open glade west of the stockade.
Tell Grocer Pippkin the mayflies are gone.
steps.says: Five swarms gone! The berries thank you, and so do I. Here, for your trouble.

quests.notes: Ours: the brownies' second starter quest; the mayfly swarms are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: The Road to Rivervale
quests.offer: The halflings of Rivervale keep good tables and open doors, and they have always been kind to our kind. I can send you to them, and Rivervale will be your home. Shall I?
quests.declined: Rivervale will keep. Halflings are patient about guests.
quests.started: Mind your manners, and save me a pie!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Burrowby when you are ready to go to Rivervale.

quests.declined: Then flit about hungry. You will be back.
quests.started: Nettlewick is by the old pines, a short flight east of here.

steps.journal: Find Grocer Nettlewick by the old pines east of the elder.
steps.says: Brightwing sent you? Here, a boiled egg. It is bigger than you are, but you will manage.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Brightwing.
steps.says: Good! Now Nettlewick knows you, and you know where the honey is kept. That is a fine start for any pixie.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the pixies' first, at their home zone, Misty Thicket of the disc.

quests.name: Rats in the Brambles
quests.offer: Bramble rats have been nibbling at my stores. They are twice your size, but they are slow. Hunt five of them in the brambles south-west of the elder's pines and I will pay you well.
quests.declined: Then the rats get fatter and I get poorer.
quests.started: Five rats. Stay out of reach of their teeth.

steps.journal: Kill five bramble rats in the brambles south-west of the elder's pines.
Tell Grocer Nettlewick the rats are dead.
steps.says: Five rats! Small wings, big heart. Here is your pay, and well earned.

quests.notes: Ours: the pixies' second starter quest; the bramble rats are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: The Elves' Wood
quests.offer: The elves of Tethelin and the Fayspires have always welcomed our kind, and they will teach you as their own. I can send you to them, and you will make your home there. Ready to fly?
quests.declined: The elves are patient. They live a long time.
quests.started: Fly well, little spark!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Thistlewhirl when you are ready to go to the elves.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Tethelin or Fayspire by class, the pixie's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. quests.accept: I will go and see her.
quests.declined: Then come back when you are hungry. You will be.
quests.started: Dewberry is just west of here, by the old forge.

steps.journal: Introduce yourself to Grocer Dewberry by the old forge.
steps.says: Moonpetal sent you? Welcome, welcome! Here is some cheese for the road. Fairies cannot live on dew alone.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Moonpetal.
steps.says: Lovely. Now you have a friend in the valley, and that is worth more than any spell I could teach you.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the fairys' first, at their home zone, Twisted Tower of the disc.

quests.name: Beetles in the Garden
quests.offer: Dusk beetles have got into the gardens again, at both ends of the valley. Would you deal with five of them for me? They are slow, and they only bite a little.
quests.declined: Then the beetles will have my lettuce.
quests.started: Five beetles. Look in the gardens at either end of the valley.

steps.journal: Kill five dusk beetles in the gardens at either end of the valley.
Tell Grocer Dewberry the beetles are gone.
steps.says: Five! My garden is saved. Thank you, little friend, and take this for your trouble.

quests.notes: Ours: the fairys' second starter quest; the dusk beetles are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: The Road to Qeynos
quests.offer: The humans of Qeynos and the rangers of Surefall Glade are kind to fairies, and they will teach you all they know. I can send you to them, and that will be your home. Are you ready?
quests.declined: The humans will wait. They are slower than we are.
quests.started: Fly true, little friend!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Starling when you are ready to go to the humans of Qeynos.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Qeynos (its rangers and druids Surefall Glade), the fairy's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. quests.name: Fresh Pup
quests.offer: A new pup at the fire! Good. The pack feeds its own, but you must know who feeds it. Go to Snaggle by the cook pots and let him take your scent. Then come back to me.
quests.declined: Then you eat last, pup. The pack waits for no one.
quests.started: Snaggle is by the cook pots, just south of the fire.

steps.journal: Let Grocer Snaggle take your scent by the cook pots.
steps.says: Grawl sent you? Here, pup, chew on this. It is mostly meat.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Grawl.
steps.says: Good. Snaggle knows your scent now. A gnoll the pack knows is never alone.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the gnolls' first, at their home zone, Blackburrow of the disc.

quests.name: Badgers on the Hill
quests.offer: Hill badgers keep digging under the stockade to get at my pots. Go up the hill north-west of the camp and kill five of them for me. I will pay, and maybe there will be badger stew.
quests.declined: Then the badgers eat, and so do I, eventually.
quests.started: Five badgers. They bite, so bite first.

steps.journal: Kill five hill badgers on the hill north-west of the camp.
Tell Grocer Snaggle the badgers are dead.
steps.says: Five badgers! You hunt like a proper gnoll. Here, this is yours.

quests.notes: Ours: the gnolls' second starter quest; the hill badgers are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: The Road to Neriak
quests.offer: The dark elves of Neriak have use for gnolls with sharp noses and sharper teeth, and they treat the pack fairly enough. I can send you to them, and Neriak will be your home. Ready?
quests.declined: Neriak will keep. The dark elves are not going anywhere.
quests.started: Hunt well, and keep your nose to the wind!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Brindle when you are ready to go to Neriak.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Neriak, the gnoll's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. Repeatable, so a gnoll back in Blackburrow is sent again; no reward, so none is had twice.

quests.name: Blood of the Camp
quests.offer: Another whelp for the camp. Good. Strong arms are always welcome. First, go and see Bulgash at the cook fire. An orc who does not eat does not fight, and an orc who does not fight is no orc.
quests.declined: Then come back when your belly is louder than your pride.
quests.started: Bulgash is at the cook fire, west of the totems.

steps.journal: See Grocer Bulgash at the cook fire.
steps.says: Gorruk sent you? Eat this, whelp. It is tough, but so are you.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Gorruk.
steps.says: Good. Now you know where the meat is. The rest you will learn by fighting.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the orcs' first, at their home zone, Thedruk of the disc.

quests.name: Rats in the Camp
quests.offer: Camp rats! They get into everything. Go down the slope to the west, past the trees, and kill five of them. Bring me nothing back. I have enough rats.
quests.declined: Then I will eat the rats myself.
quests.started: Five rats. Do not let them bite your ankles.

steps.journal: Kill five camp rats on the slope west of the camp.
Tell Grocer Bulgash the rats are dead.
steps.says: Five rats! Ha! You will make a fine warrior. Here, take this coin.

quests.notes: Ours: the orcs' second starter quest; the camp rats are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: The Road to Halas
quests.offer: The barbarians of Halas fight giants and ice, and they respect an orc who fights beside them. There is peace between us, rough as it is. I can send you to them. Are you ready?
quests.declined: Halas is cold. It will still be cold tomorrow.
quests.started: Fight well, and do not let the cold bite!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Thrakka when you are ready to go to Halas.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Halas, the orc's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. Repeatable, so a orc back in Thedruk is sent again; no reward, so none is had twice.

quests.name: Horns and Hunger
quests.offer: Another calf for the herd! Stand up straight. Before you lower those horns at anyone, go and see Brassnose at the mine cart outside. He keeps the food, and he keeps it from fools.
quests.declined: Then go hungry, calf, and learn the hard way.
quests.started: Brassnose is by the mine cart, just outside the mine.

steps.journal: See Grocer Brassnose by the mine cart outside the mine.
steps.says: Hornbrand sent you? Here, calf. Eat, and grow those horns.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Hornbrand.
steps.says: Good. A full belly and a hard head. That is all a minotaur needs to begin.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the minotaurs' first, at their home zone, Gerntar Mines of the disc.

quests.name: Rats in the Grain
quests.offer: Mine rats are in the grain again. They come up out of the grass east of the mine. Kill five of them, calf, and I will pay you. Trample them if you like.
quests.declined: Then the rats eat the grain, and the herd eats the rats.
quests.started: Five rats. They are small, so look down.

steps.journal: Kill five mine rats in the grass east of the mine.
Tell Grocer Brassnose the rats are dead.
steps.says: Five rats! The grain is safe, for now. Here is your coin.

quests.notes: Ours: the minotaurs' second starter quest; the mine rats are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: The Road to Grobb
quests.offer: The trolls of Grobb do not care how big your horns are, only how hard you hit. They will take you in as one of their own. I can send you to them, and Grobb will be your home. Ready?
quests.declined: Grobb will still be there. So will the trolls.
quests.started: Hit hard, and keep your horns sharp!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Stonehoof when you are ready to go to Grobb.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Grobb, the minotaur's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. quests.name: Bones Awake
quests.offer: So, another of us wakes. Do not be alarmed. The bones remember how to walk. First, go and see Marrowby, just down the hall. He trades with the living who come by, and he will want to know you.
quests.declined: We have all the time in the world. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Marrowby is just down the hall, toward the light.

steps.journal: See Grocer Marrowby down the hall.
steps.says: Ossric sent you? Take this bread. We do not eat it, but the living you meet will, and a gift opens doors.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Ossric.
steps.says: Good. You walk, you speak, you make friends. The rest will come back to you in time.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the skeletons' first, at their home zone, Tomb of Kings of the disc.

quests.name: Beetles in the Bones
quests.offer: Tomb beetles are gnawing at the old halls to the west. They have no respect for the dead, and they are fond of my stock. Kill five of them and I will pay you well.
quests.declined: Then they will gnaw on, as beetles do.
quests.started: Five beetles, in the west halls past the old guard posts.

steps.journal: Kill five tomb beetles in the west halls of the tomb.
Tell Grocer Marrowby the beetles are dead.
steps.says: Five! The halls are quieter already. Here is your pay. Spend it on something the living sell.

quests.notes: Ours: the skeletons' second starter quest; the tomb beetles are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: The Road to Freeport
quests.offer: The living fear us, but Freeport is not so particular, and its darker guilds will take you in. I can send you there, and it will be your home from then on. Are you ready to go?
quests.declined: The tomb is patient. So am I.
quests.started: Walk tall, and keep your bones together!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Dustcloak when you are ready to go to Freeport.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Freeport, the skeleton's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. Repeatable, so a skeleton back in Tomb of Kings is sent again; no reward, so none is had twice.

quests.name: A New Sprout
quests.offer: Ah. A new sprout. Welcome to the hall, little one. There is no hurry here, but there is supper. Go slowly over to Puffstool, by the north wall, and let her know you have come up.
quests.declined: There is no hurry. There never is.
quests.started: Puffstool is by the north wall. Take your time.

steps.journal: Find Grocer Puffstool by the north wall of the hall.
steps.says: Moldcap sent you? Welcome, sprout. Here is some flax bread. It is dry, but so is the air up top.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Moldcap.
steps.says: Good. Now you know the hall, and the hall knows you. That is the first thing, and the most important.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the fungusmans' first, at their home zone, Guk of the disc.

quests.name: Beetles at the Caps
quests.offer: Cave beetles come in from the east passage and nibble at the young caps. It is very rude of them. Would you see to five of them for me? Slowly is fine. Thoroughly is better.
quests.declined: The caps will grow back. Eventually.
quests.started: Five beetles, by the east passage.

steps.journal: Kill five cave beetles by the east passage of the hall.
Tell Grocer Puffstool the beetles are gone.
steps.says: Five! The young caps thank you. So do I. Here, for your trouble.

quests.notes: Ours: the fungusmans' second starter quest; the cave beetles are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: Up to the Light
quests.offer: Up above, the elves of Tethelin and the Fayspires keep shaded groves where our spores grow well, and they are kind to slow folk. I can send you up to them, and that will be your home. Ready?
quests.declined: There is no hurry. The elves live a long time.
quests.started: Grow well, sprout, up in the light!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Gillford when you are ready to go up to the elves.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Tethelin or Fayspire by class, the fungusman's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. Repeatable, so a fungusman back in Guk is sent again; no reward, so none is had twice.

quests.name: First Light
quests.offer: A new light in the swamp! Welcome, little flame. The humans you will walk among eat bread and carry coin, and you must learn their ways. Begin with Flicker. She trades with travellers.
quests.declined: Drift a while, then. The swamp is in no hurry.
quests.started: Flicker glows down by the south pond. You cannot miss her.

steps.journal: Find Grocer Flicker by the south pond.
steps.says: Faintglow sent you? Here, take this bread. You will not eat it, but in Qeynos it helps to carry what humans carry.

steps.journal: Return to Elder Faintglow.
steps.says: Good. You learn quickly, little flame. Keep your light low among the humans, and they will hardly know.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the wisps' first, at their home zone, West Feerrott of the disc.

quests.name: Rats in the Reeds
quests.offer: Bog rats chew at the travellers' packs I keep for trade. They hide in the reeds east of the elder. Put out five of them for me, little flame, and I will share the coin.
quests.declined: Then the rats will dine on bread tonight.
quests.started: Five rats, in the reeds east of the elder.

steps.journal: Kill five bog rats in the reeds east of Elder Faintglow.
Tell Grocer Flicker the rats are gone.
steps.says: Five! The packs are safe. Here is your share, bright one.

quests.notes: Ours: the wisps' second starter quest; the bog rats are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: A Shape for Qeynos
quests.offer: In Qeynos the humans will take you for one of their own, so long as your armour holds its shape around you. I can send you there, and it will be your home. Are you ready to go?
quests.declined: The swamp will hold your light a while longer.
quests.started: Burn bright, and keep your helm on!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Dimlight when you are ready to go to Qeynos.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Qeynos (its rangers and druids Surefall Glade), the wisp's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. Repeatable, so a wisp back in West Feerrott is sent again; no reward, so none is had twice.

items.name: river-shell charm
items.description: A chip of river shell on a reed cord. Every young kappa of the Dwell wears one.

items.name: marsh rat tail
items.description: The tail of a marsh rat from the shore where the Dwell's causeway lands.

items.name: braided reed cord
items.description: A length of river reed, braided tight by the Dwell's netmenders.

items.name: mudfang scale
items.description: A broad scale from a mudfang basilisk of the flats south of the Dwell's shore.

items.name: Gulpjaw's tooth
items.description: A long tooth of the blue basilisk Gulpjaw.

items.name: pup's digging sash
items.description: A sash of tunnel-rat hide, knotted in clan Kolbok's way. Every pup of the Warrens wears one.

items.name: tunnel beetle horn
items.description: The horn of a tunnel beetle from the west end of the Warrens' cavern.

items.name: rat-hide lacing
items.description: A long lace cut from tunnel-rat hide by the Warrens' stitchers.

items.name: deepway millipede leg
items.description: A hard, jointed leg from a deepway millipede of the Warrens' south tunnels.

items.name: Gravelmaw's mandible
items.description: A notched mandible of the scythe beetle Gravelmaw.

items.name: tideline ring
items.description: A ring of twisted wire scavenged from the tide line. Every young ratman of the shore camp wears one.

items.name: dune snake fang
items.description: The fang of a dune snake from the sand east of the ratmen's shore camp.

items.name: salvaged net cord
items.description: A length of tarred cord picked out of a net the tide left on the ratmen's shore.

items.name: tidewrack crab claw
items.description: The heavy claw of a tidewrack crab from the tide line by the ratmen's shore camp.

items.name: Hoodscale's fang
items.description: A long, hollow fang of the cobra Hoodscale.

items.name: reveler's bangle
items.description: A bangle of carved vine-wood that clicks in time when its wearer dances. Every young satyr of the glade wears one.

items.name: glade spiderling leg
items.description: The leg of a glade spiderling from the grass east of the satyrs' glade.

items.name: twisted vine cord
items.description: A cord of green vine, twisted tight by the reedcutters of the satyrs' glade.

items.name: mead wasp stinger
items.description: The stinger of a mead wasp from the woods south-east of the satyrs' glade.

items.name: Nightpelt's fang
items.description: A long fang of the shadow panther Nightpelt.

items.name: acorn-cap earring
items.description: The cap of an acorn from the grove's first oak, hung on a thread of bark. Every young dryad of the grove wears one.

items.name: bark beetle shell
items.description: The shell of a bark beetle from the woods west of the dryads' lake.

items.name: willow-bark cord
items.description: A cord of willow bark, peeled and twisted by the weavers of the dryads' grove.

items.name: rootcoil snake skin
items.description: The mottled skin of a rootcoil snake from the deep woods west of the dryads' lake.

items.name: Rotbark's heartwood
items.description: A knot of blackened heartwood from the rotting shambler Rotbark.

items.name: stonewake band
items.description: A band of crag-lizard hide set with a chip of the roost's own rock. Every newly woken gargoyle of the crag wears one.

items.name: crag bat wing
items.description: The leathery wing of a crag bat from the foot of the gargoyles' crag.

items.name: crag-hide thong
items.description: A thong cut from crag-lizard hide by the hidecutters of the gargoyles' roost.

items.name: cragside skink tail
items.description: The thick tail of a cragside skink from the barrens east of the gargoyles' crag.

items.name: Grindstone's core
items.description: The hard knot of rock at the heart of the sand-thing Grindstone.

items.name: fledgling's wingband
items.description: A band of knotted reed and down. Every fledgling of the Roost wears one on its wing.

items.name: scrub rat tail
items.description: The tail of a scrub rat from the grass north of the Roost.

items.name: brush wasp stinger
items.description: The stinger of a brush wasp from the hill west of the Roost.

items.name: Razortusk's tusk
items.description: The chipped tusk of the old boar Razortusk.
